content.text: Relational bug found. Check the document one too.

candidates.explanation: The exclusion filter uses `id: Not(Number(conditions.userId))`, so it excludes the session whose id equals the user's id. It should exclude `excludeSessionId`. After a password change, every session of the user is soft-deleted except the one whose id happens to equal the user id, which is usually an unrelated older session. The current session is deleted, so its next refresh call returns 401.

fix.description: Exclude the current session id instead of the user id in the Not() filter.

candidates.explanation: The exclusion filter uses `id: Not(Number(conditions.userId))`, so it excludes the session whose id equals the user's id. It should exclude `excludeSessionId`. After a password change, every session of the user is soft-deleted except the one whose id happens to equal the user id, which is usually an unrelated older session. The current session is deleted, so its next refresh call returns 401.

fix.description: Exclude the current session id instead of the user id in the Not() filter.
